issue.title: Reading Board reads the shared ref-library snapshot instead of spawning its own bob ref list

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (note #11, F2 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent.

Make the Reading Board read the shared ref-library snapshot the Ref Card already uses, instead of spawning its own `bob ref list`. Today bob-ledger-tools 241-plugin-reading-board-data.js:12 builds `["ref", "list", "-s", "ready,next,wip", "-A", "-f", "json"]` and keeps its own flight and cache. Meanwhile the Ref Card's report service (241a-plugin-ref-library-report-service.js plus 241ak-plugin-ref-library-report.js, from bob-cli-qp.3) holds one lazily subscribed, stale-while-revalidate full-library `bob ref list -A -R all -f json` snapshot indexed by path, with debounced revalidation and no spawns from paint. The board would subscribe to that service, filter ready/next/wip in memory, and keep its schema-version check, error rows, and the "retry once, then run in a terminal" hint (241:220). Both surfaces already share the kind vocabulary (240v).

Verify that the full-library snapshot carries every field the board reads (audio path, lanes, priorities) and that its refresh triggers cover the board's (task edits, `bob ref` runs). Board refresh must not regress: the board may open with no Ref Card mounted, so the service must start lazily for the board alone. Prove there is one `bob ref list` spawn per revalidation with both surfaces open.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Ref Cards plan put the Reading Board consumer out of scope while bob-cli-qm was in flight and listed it as follow-up F2. The epic only shared the vocabulary with the board, not the data path.

issue.creation_reason: After Ref Cards, two surfaces each spawn and cache their own bob ref list for the same library; the plan's follow-up F2 asks the board to reuse the Ref Card's shared report service.
